social_and_video_referrals.regex_check: 9 sources match the anchored social regex; chatgpt.com does not, as it should.
social_and_video_referrals.finding: YouTube visits engage at 72.5% against 60.2% for the whole site, and bring 3.38 key events per 100 sessions against 2.62. A visit from a creator's video is worth more than an average visit. Other social engages at 53.2% with 1.53 key events per 100 sessions, below the site, so the plan leads with YouTube. Social and video visits land most on /blog/reduce-no-shows/, a blog post; the creator links point at the online booking page instead, which the brief names.

past_influencer_utms.finding: One past creator test: 215 sessions, 138 engaged (64.2%) and 8 key events for a 600 USD fee: 4.35 USD per engaged session and 75.00 USD per key event. That is the benchmark for the new campaign. The same creator's links used two mediums, "influencer" and "Creator"; the filter caught both because it ignores case, but a report on one medium would miss 29 sessions. The new plan uses utm_medium=influencer for every link.

conversions.why: Both key events fire (1187 in 90 days), so the plan's KPI is key events, with engaged sessions as the early read.

intent_signals.signal: asks which booking app the coach uses
asks whether clients can pay a deposit when they book online
asks if reminders go out by text or only by email
asks whether online booking works for a salon with 6 chairs

Creator A.read: Mostly praise from salon owners: 30 of 51 audience comments are positive. The 12 questions ask which booking app the coach uses, about deposits at booking and about text reminders, all things the product does. The 3 friction comments are about the creator's own broken links, not the topic. Negative plus spam is 3.9%, a clear pass.

intent_signals.signal: asks whether patients can reschedule without calling
asks which app sends the reminders automatically
asks how to stop clients booking the wrong appointment length

Creator B.read: Negative plus spam is 20.0% (2 negative, 4 spam) of 30 audience comments, over the 15% line, so the creator is flagged. It isn't borderline: one comment fewer still leaves 16.7%. The spam is other booking services and lead sellers advertising in the replies, and the two negatives criticise the advice, not the creator's honesty. Read them before you approach. The questions (automatic reminders, rescheduling without a phone call) are strong hooks.

plan.objective: Trial sign-ups from salon and clinic owners, through https://www.example.com/features/online-booking/.
plan.kpi: Key events (sign_up and demo_request) from influencer links; engaged sessions as the early read. Benchmark from the summer test: 4.35 USD per engaged session, 75.00 USD per key event.
plan.tier_mix: Phase 1: Creator B (micro), Creator C (nano). Phase 2: Creator A (mid).
plan.deliverables_per_creator: One 60 to 90 second integration in a YouTube video, the tracked link high in the description and in a pinned comment, and one short social post.
plan.timeline: Phase 1 runs for 30 days from the first video. Phase 2 starts after the day-30 check.

phase_2.why: The mid creator rated approach first, once phase 1 gives a cost per engaged session.

brief.goal: Trial sign-ups from salon and clinic owners, through the online booking page.
brief.audience: Owners and front-desk staff of salons, clinics and studios with 1 to 20 staff.
brief.key_message: Clients book themselves online, and automatic reminders cut no-shows.
talking_points: Clients book and pay a deposit online, any time, from one booking page.
Automatic text and email reminders, with a reschedule link in the reminder.
Two-way calendar sync, so the front desk and the booking page never clash.

Deposits taken when the client books
One booking page for every chair and staff member
Clients reschedule from the reminder, no phone call
Each service books its own length
must_say: The disclosure at the start (see captions and scripts).
The tracked link, said out loud and in the description.
dont: Don't promise a no-show rate or a revenue number.
Don't describe features you haven't used.
Don't show client names or phone numbers on screen.
brief.deliverables: One 60 to 90 second integration in a YouTube video, the tracked link high in the description and in a pinned comment, and one short social post.
brief.dates: Script to us 7 days before publishing; publish within the 30-day phase window.
brief.link: Each creator's own UTM link from the tracking table.
brief.disclosure: Say "This video is sponsored by Example Booking Software" and show it on screen when the segment starts; turn on YouTube's paid promotion label as well.

assets.outreach_email_to_creator_b:
Subject: Your front-desk no-show routine

Hi, your video on the front-desk routine that cuts no-shows is one of the most practical we've seen, and your viewers keep asking which app sends the reminders and whether patients can reschedule without calling.

We make Example Booking Software. Clients book online, get automatic text and email reminders, and reschedule from the reminder itself, so the front desk takes fewer calls.

Would you make one 60 to 90 second sponsored segment in an upcoming video, with a tracked link? We can do a flat fee, product access, or both. We'll set you up first so you can try it at a clinic before you decide.

Thanks,
[Your name], Example Booking Software

giveaway.dates: Opens when the video goes live and closes 14 days later.
giveaway.how_to_enter: Comment with the one booking problem you'd fix first.
giveaway.winner: Picked at random from eligible comments, announced in a pinned comment, contacted within 7 days.
giveaway.prize: 12 months of the Growth plan, worth 588 USD (49 USD a month).
giveaway.rules: No purchase necessary. Official rules on a page the description links to. Follows YouTube's contest policies. The post says it's sponsored.

paid_amplification.plan: After the day-7 check, run the best-performing creator post as a paid partnership ad, using the 600 USD reserve.
paid_amplification.conditions: Only with the creator's written permission and an agreed usage window. Set up in the ad platform; this skill runs no ad actions.
